Akshay Nanasaheb Garad Associate Process Manager

akkigaradpatil@gmail.com 8275322966

linkedin.com/in/akshay-garad-patil1312

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Capital Markets professional with over 6 years of experience in OTC Trade Confirmations, Settlements, Derivatives Operations, and Middle Office within global investment banking environments. Expert in managing the Trade Life Cycle for FX, IRS, and Equity Derivatives, with a proven track record in trade validation, reconciliation, and exception management. Strong leadership background managing teams of up to 6 members while ensuring strict UK regulatory compliance and T+1/T+2 timeline adherence.

EDUCATION

MGM IOM - Aurangabad MBA, Finance

2020 | Aurangabad

Deogiri Institute of Technology and Management - Aurangabad BCA, Management

2018 | Aurangabad

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

eClerx Services Limited - Pune Associate Process Manager Process: Trade Settlement Directly manage and allocate workflow for a 5-member team specializing in Trade Settlement operations Perform daily reconciliation of trade executions against middle-office captures to ensure 100% accuracy of economic details. Managing relationships with brokers and internal ‘clients’ such as Senior Level Management. Confirm and match trades in CTM or via email. Execute pre-matching by proactively contacting counterparties to confirm Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), trade economics and avoid potential bottlenecks. Investigated and resolved failed trades arising from short positions, incorrect instructions, or late bookings. Working on booking discrepancies in commission, fees, broker. Ensuring that all settlement issues are handled properly. Working with CTM to check trade status. Maintain and update SOPs and DTOPs, securing periodic client sign-offs to ensure process standardization.

10/2025 – Present

eClerx Services Limited - Pune Associate Process Manager Process: OTC Trade Confirmation Business as usual (BAU)- Led an 6-member team focused on OTC trade validation and confirmation for FX, IRS, and Equity Derivatives. Managed the end-to-end Trade Life Cycle, including drafting complex confirmations and resolving high-risk exceptions. Conducted Second-Level Audits and Trade Surveillance to ensure all post-trade activities met stringent UK regulatory compliance standards. Worked on Trade Lifecycle (pre-trade / post-trade) activity. Draft, review, and validate OTC trade confirmations for FX, IRS, and Equity Derivatives. Ensure confirmations are processed within regulatory timelines for UK region.

10/2024 – 10/2025

Perform second-level audit checks before dispatching confirmations to counterparties. Coordinated weekly client calls to review ageing items and high-risk trades, providing accurate commentary and mitigation strategies. Escalate aged and high-risk trades and maintain accurate commentary. Prepare monthly MIS, productivity, and audit reports.

eClerx Services Limited - Pune Senior Analyst Process: OTC Paper & Electronic Trade Confirmation Business as usual (BAU): • Processed OTC electronic and paper trade confirmations within regulatory timelines (T+1 / T+2). • Worked on TradeServ for electronic trade matching and affirmation. • Matched counterparty alleges against booking details to confirm trade accuracy. • Drafted and matched trade confirmations for Equity and IRP OTC trades. • Followed up with counterparties for affirmation and exception resolution. • Resolved DKs by coordinating with brokers, middle office, and front office teams. • Updated affirmation status, comments, and reconciliation details accurately. • Checked settlement status during affirmation and coordinated with counterparties. • Supported ad-hoc client and internal requests alongside BAU activities.

08/2022 – 10/2024

State Street Syntel Services Pvt. Ltd Associate Process: Reference Data / SSI Business as usual (BAU)- • Created and maintained bank accounts, broker codes, and settlement instructions. • Updated SSIs across Omgeo ALERT, DTCC, and internal applications. • Coordinated with banks, brokers, and internal teams for instruction setup and changes. • Supported bank change activities and communicated updates to stakeholders. • Prepared EOD activity reports and shared with oversight teams. • Supported client onboarding and account setup activities, including client documentation,

06/2020 – 08/2022

SSI setup, and coordination with banks, brokers, and internal teams.
